name: com.likeminds.likemindschat.utils.notification.NotificationActionBroadcastReceiver
description: LikeMinds Chat-v1 runs this receiver when a user taps follow, reply, or mark-as-read actions in a chat notification. It also handles other notification buttons, such as voting or event actions, by submitting the requested action or opening its related screen.
disableEffect: Chat and event notification buttons stop updating or opening their related content.
